title: Prepare for restoring a software wallet safely

summary.text: Restoration requires the correct private backup and wallet type. This guide is for software wallets; hardware-wallet users should use the pairing guide.

problem.text: Restore recovery wallet backup missing balance zero balance after restore

symptoms.text: Restore recovery wallet backup missing balance zero balance after restore

user_phrases.text: Restore recovery wallet backup missing balance zero balance after restore

daedalus.notes: Interface source inspected at Daedalus 11.0.0. Later versions and specific OS releases require another review; safety advice is Ariadne editorial policy.

causes.claim: A symptom alone does not establish a cause.

resolutions.action: Confirm privately that you have the original backup for the intended software wallet before starting. Keep the current installation and data intact.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: In the genuine Daedalus application, choose the restoration option and the matching wallet type. If uncertain about legacy types, stop and ask staff before proceeding.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

resolutions.action: Follow the local application prompts privately. After restoration, compare the expected funds and history. Unexpected results need investigation, not deletion of the original wallet.
resolutions.why: Use the inspected interface and avoid unsupported troubleshooting.

expected_outcome.text: The restored wallet should match the intended wallet. An unexpected balance does not by itself identify the cause.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

prerequisites: Have the original private backup and identify the wallet type. Do not erase the existing wallet or backup.
consequences: Using the wrong backup can display a different wallet. Losing the only backup can make recovery impossible.
recovery: Stop if unsure; contact human support before changing wallet data.

evidence.rationale: Official source inspection and Ariadne safety review; not wallet runtime testing.

faq.reason: Conservative source-reviewed introduction; not an exhaustive troubleshooting procedure.
